policy: After component splitting, fill blank fields only using explicitly reviewed individual observations or unique exact Gaia DR3 component matches. Published calibration masses/radii are estimates. Never substitute G/K for Johnson V, adopt ambiguous aggregate photometry, or assign a parent photospheric metallicity to a secondary. Systemic RVs give explicitly approximate bulk motion, not orbital velocity. Explicit corrections may replace a reviewed expected input value and abundance kind; input drift fails generation. [M/H] and [Fe/H] are retained as distinct source quantities.
